about_short_description.short_description: Tim Hortons Gulf Franchise managed by Dubai-based fashion and lifestyle retail conglomerate Apparel Group.

product.name: Hot Beverages
product.description: A range of hot drinks made from 100% Premium Arabica Beans including espresso, French Vanilla, lattes, cappuccinos, hot chocolate, and selected teas.

product.name: Cold Beverages
product.description: A selection of chilled drinks including iced cappuccinos, iced coffee, iced lattes, iced chocolate, refreshers, juices, and ready-to-drink beverages.

product.name: Baked Goods
product.description: Freshly baked items such as donuts, Timbits, cookies, cakes, croissants, and muffins.

product.name: Breakfast Items
product.description: A variety of bagels and muffin sandwiches, including options tailored to local tastes such as Halloumi Mint and Turkey Sausage & Egg croissants.

product.name: Sandwiches and More
product.description: A range of sandwiches including wraps, paninis, croissants, and salads, with options reflecting international and local flavor profiles.

product.name: Canned Coffee Products
product.description: Packaged versions of Tim Hortons' premium blend and French Vanilla coffee available in cans for at-home consumption.
